name: Sven Mikser - § 1 - Am 4
title: REPORT on the 2023 and 2024 Commission reports on Moldova
part_text: 1. Acknowledges Moldova’s stated commitment and the progress made on EU accession-related reforms despite internal and external challenges, which made it possible for accession negotiations to start in June 2024; takes note of the reform efforts undertaken, but stresses that alternative forms of structured cooperation should be explored which do not necessarily lead to full EU membership;
